mathematical_meanings: Left image: O names the center of the circle (the interior dot in the circle with an inscribed quadrilateral). Right image: O names the center of the circle (the dot on the line through the middle of the circle).
Rationales: In both images, O names the center of the circle. The relevant locations are the interior dot in the circle with an inscribed quadrilateral on the left and the dot on the line through the middle of the circle on the right.
